content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Zonal Security Officer: Graduate in any discipline. Must have been in the rank of DSP or equivalent in Police/Army/Paramilitary forces with minimum three years experience as DSP or equivalent. FL Counsellor: Graduate from a recognized institute with minimum 1 year work experience in Banking/related fields. Working knowledge of computers and local language. Knowledge of conducting Financial Literacy camps. Preference to J&K Bank Officer superannuated in normal course.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 62 years as on 01-01-2026.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Zonal Security Officer: Rs. 45,000/- Per Month. FL Counsellor: Rs. 22,000/- Per Month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of J&K Bank to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for J&K Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the J&K Bank Recruitment 2026 is 25th September 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Zonal Security Officer and FL Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies. 6 vacancies are for the Zonal Security Officer post and 2 vacancies are for the FL Counsellor post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Zonal Security Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Zonal Security Officer position, candidates must be Graduates in any discipline and should have served as a DSP or equivalent in Police/Army/Paramilitary forces with at least three years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these J&K Bank posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 62 years as of 1st January 2026. There is no minimum age specified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for J&K Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories (General/OBC, SC/ST) is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a screening of applications followed by an interview or interaction with the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Zonal Security Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Zonal Security Officer post will receive a salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the FL Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The FL Counsellor post offers a monthly salary of Rs. 22,000/-.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any preference for retired J&K Bank officers for the FL Counsellor role?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to J&K Bank Officers who have retired in the normal course for the FL Counsellor position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for J&K Bank Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section on this page. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
